day4_start.name: Me
day4_start.text: *...I open my eyes. It's Saturday morning. My heart is already racing.*

day4_morning_dream.name: Me
day4_morning_dream.text: *Last night, I had a strange dream. Everything that happened at school flashed by like a panorama.*

day4_morning_wake.name: Me
day4_morning_wake.text: *Today is... finally the day. I could barely sleep last night.*

day4_morning_calendar.name: Me
day4_morning_calendar.text: *I check the calendar on my phone. 'Saturday' — the red letters stand out more than usual.*

day4_morning_excitement.name: Me
day4_morning_excitement.text: *It's only been four days since I transferred here. I never expected such an exciting weekend. My heart is pounding.*

day4_morning_guilt.name: Me
day4_morning_guilt.text: *...Wait. I feel uneasy about having promised multiple people. They all trusted me when they made plans... but in the end, I can only meet one of them.*

day4_morning_stretch.name: Me
day4_morning_stretch.text: *I stretch wide and kick off the blankets. Today, I'm going to live without any regrets.*

day4_morning_mirror.name: Me
day4_morning_mirror.text: *Standing in front of the mirror, I see my nervous face. I wish I could look a little cooler...*

day4_morning_window.name: Me
day4_morning_window.text: *I pull back the curtains and bright sunlight pours in. It's so bright outside.*

day4_morning_weather.name: Me
day4_morning_weather.text: *The sky is endlessly clear. Cherry blossom petals drift in the breeze, and birds are singing. A perfect Saturday morning.*

day4_morning_weather2.name: Me
day4_morning_weather2.text: *Through the window, I can see the neighborhood streets. People out for walks, couples heading into cafés... I'll be out there too, soon.*

day4_morning_kitchen.name: Me
day4_morning_kitchen.text: *I head to the kitchen. Let me check what's in the fridge.*

day4_morning_breakfast_choice.name: Me
day4_morning_breakfast_choice.text: *I have plenty of time, but... what should I do about breakfast?*
choices: At least grab some toast before heading out
Too excited to eat — skip it

day4_morning_breakfast_eat.name: Me
day4_morning_breakfast_eat.text: *I spread jam on a slice of toast and take a bite. The crispy texture shakes off the drowsiness. Nothing beats a good breakfast.*

day4_morning_breakfast_skip.name: Me
day4_morning_breakfast_skip.text: *I'm hungry, but I'm too nervous to taste anything anyway. I'll grab something on the way.*

day4_morning_breakfast_done.name: Me
day4_morning_breakfast_done.text: *Alright, time to wash up and get ready. I've got plenty of time.*

day4_morning_groom.name: Me
day4_morning_groom.text: *I wash my face and fix my hair. I styled it more carefully than usual. Maybe... just a little cologne too.*

day4_morning_nervous.name: Me
day4_morning_nervous.text: *I check my reflection in the mirror one more time. Not bad. ...But why am I shaking so much?*

day4_morning_closet.name: Me
day4_morning_closet.text: *I open the closet. Besides my school uniform, I don't have that many options. What should I wear?*

day4_morning_outfit.name: Me
day4_morning_outfit.text: *What should I go with? First impressions matter, so I need to choose carefully.*

day4_outfit_casual.name: Me
day4_outfit_casual.text: *Comfort is king. Dressing naturally is my style.*

day4_casual_mirror.name: Me
day4_casual_mirror.text: *I do a spin in front of the mirror. White shirt and jeans... clean and effortless. Looks good.*

day4_outfit_stylish.name: Me
day4_outfit_stylish.text: *Today is special, after all. This should be fine, right?*

day4_stylish_mirror.name: Me
day4_stylish_mirror.text: *The jacket fits just right, and the slacks make my legs look longer. I look different from usual, which feels a bit unfamiliar... but not bad.*

day4_morning_outfit_done.name: Me
day4_morning_outfit_done.text: *Good, outfit decided. Now I just need to check my phone and head out.*

day4_morning_phone.name: Me
day4_morning_phone.text: *I check my phone. There's a message waiting.*

day4_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_msg_seoyeon.text: "You didn't forget about today, right? 😊 Meet me at the park fountain at 10! I can't wait!"

day4_morning_reply_seoyeon.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_seoyeon.text: *A message from Seoyeon. That smiley emoji is cute. What should I reply...*

day4_msg_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_msg_seoyeon_2.text: "Oh, and the weather's so nice today! Perfect for a walk. Don't forget sunscreen!"

day4_reply_seoyeon_2.name: Me
day4_reply_seoyeon_2.text: *She keeps sending messages back to back. She must be excited too. I should hurry up and get ready.*

day4_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_msg_yuna.text: "...10 o'clock. Café by the station. Don't be late."

day4_morning_reply_yuna.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_yuna.text: *Short and to the point — so typical of Yuna. But that's part of her charm. I type back, 'Got it, I won't be late!'*

day4_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
day4_msg_yuna_2.text: "...It's nothing special. I just wanted some coffee. ...It's just weird going alone."

day4_reply_yuna_2.name: Me
day4_reply_yuna_2.text: *...That's Yuna-speak for 'I want to go together,' right? A smile spreads across my face.*

day4_msg_dain.name: Dain
day4_msg_dain.text: "HEY!! Let's meet up after practice today!! In front of the gym at 11!! Don't be late!!!! 🏐"

day4_morning_reply_dain.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_dain.text: *So many exclamation marks... Dain's energy comes through even in her texts. Better send a reply.*

day4_msg_dain_2.name: Dain
day4_msg_dain_2.text: "Oh right!! I'm gonna be STARVING after practice!! Find us a good restaurant!! I want meat!!!"

day4_reply_dain_2.name: Me
day4_reply_dain_2.text: *She's even making me look up restaurants... Then again, eating with Dain doesn't sound bad. No — I'm actually looking forward to it.*

day4_msg_nurse.name: School Nurse
day4_msg_nurse.text: "If you're free today... how about the art museum downtown? There's an exhibition I'd like to see. Let's meet in front of the museum at 11."

day4_morning_reply_nurse.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_nurse.text: *The art museum with the school nurse... My heart is fluttering. I replied, 'Yes, I'll definitely be there!'*

day4_msg_nurse_2.name: School Nurse
day4_msg_nurse_2.text: "I'll be looking forward to it. Oh, and... don't call me 'ma'am' today. Let's just meet casually."

day4_reply_nurse_2.name: Me
day4_reply_nurse_2.text: *Don't call her 'ma'am'...? I thought my heart was going to stop. Today is going to be a truly special day.*

day4_msg_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_msg_teacher.text: "Want to meet at the café near school around lunch? There's something I'd like to talk about. Let's meet at 12."

day4_morning_reply_teacher.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_teacher.text: *Meeting the homeroom teacher outside of school... I'm nervous. I sent a reply right away.*

day4_msg_teacher_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_msg_teacher_2.text: "I'll be in casual clothes, so don't be surprised if you don't recognize me. ...Just kidding. You probably will."

day4_reply_teacher_2.name: Me
day4_reply_teacher_2.text: *The homeroom teacher cracking jokes? That's a side I've never seen before — it feels refreshing. I wonder what she looks like in casual clothes.*

day4_morning_loyalty_boost.name: Me
day4_morning_loyalty_boost.text: *The fact that I'm getting ready for just one person... somehow makes me feel more certain. Today, I'll think only of them.*

day4_morning_lastcheck.name: Me
day4_morning_lastcheck.text: *One last look in the mirror. ...I look fine. No — I actually look pretty good. Let's be confident.*

day4_morning_wallet.name: Me
day4_morning_wallet.text: *Wallet, phone, keys. I put each one in my pockets. Better bring a handkerchief too, just in case.*

day4_morning_lock.name: Me
day4_morning_lock.text: *I step out the front door and lock it behind me. Click — like the sound of a brand new day beginning.*

day4_morning_outside.name: Me
day4_morning_outside.text: *A warm breeze greets me outside. The scent of cherry blossoms brushes past. The streets are full of life.*

day4_no_date_start.name: Me
day4_no_date_start.text: *...I check my phone, but there are no messages.*

day4_no_date_2.name: Me
day4_no_date_2.text: *It's the weekend and I have no plans. It's already been four days since I transferred... What have I been doing?*

day4_no_date_3.name: Me
day4_no_date_3.text: *Still, I can't just stay home on a beautiful day like this. Maybe I should go out somewhere.*
choices: Grab snacks from the convenience store and head to the park
Kill time at a local café

day4_no_date_park.name: Me
day4_no_date_park.text: *I buy a rice ball and a drink from the convenience store and head to the park. I sit on a bench, eating alone.*

day4_no_date_park_weather.name: Me
day4_no_date_park_weather.text: *Cherry blossom petals blown by the wind land on my shoulder. It's a beautiful scene... but sitting here alone, it feels a little lonely.*

day4_no_date_home.name: Me
day4_no_date_home.text: *I lie in bed staring at the ceiling. Is this really how I should be spending my day?*

day4_no_date_home_bored.name: Me
day4_no_date_home_bored.text: *I open social media and it's filled with weekend photos from classmates. Everyone looks so happy... Am I the only one like this?*

day4_no_date_cafe.name: Me
day4_no_date_cafe.text: *I walk into a local café and order an Americano. I sit by the window and gaze outside.*

day4_no_date_cafe_sit.name: Me
day4_no_date_cafe_sit.text: *I watch couples passing by on the street, sipping my coffee. The bitterness feels particularly strong today.*

day4_no_date_lonely.name: Me
day4_no_date_lonely.text: *...Spending Saturday all alone like this. But I can't just sit still. Let me take a walk.*

day4_no_date_wander.name: Me
day4_no_date_wander.text: *Walking aimlessly through the neighborhood, I end up in front of the convenience store near the park. That's when I notice a familiar figure from behind.*

day4_no_date_meet_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_no_date_meet_seoyeon.text: "Huh? What are you doing here? I just came out for a walk! Wanna join me?"

day4_no_date_chat_seoyeon.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_seoyeon.text: *Seoyeon walks up with a bright smile. I was feeling so lonely being alone, and now I run into her. Must be fate.*

day4_no_date_chat_yuna.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_yuna.text: *Yuna pulls out one earbud and looks up at me. Her quiet gaze feels surprisingly warm.*

day4_no_date_meet_dain.name: Dain
day4_no_date_meet_dain.text: "Whoa?! Running into you here!! I came to grab a drink after practice!! Wanna hang out?!"

day4_no_date_chat_dain.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_dain.text: *Dain walks up energetically in her workout clothes. I'm glad for this lively encounter.*

day4_no_date_meet_nurse.name: School Nurse
day4_no_date_meet_nurse.text: "Oh my, fancy meeting you here. I just stepped out for a walk too. Want to walk together?"

day4_no_date_chat_nurse.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_nurse.text: *I almost didn't recognize her in casual clothes. She looks so different outside of school. My heart starts racing.*

day4_no_date_meet_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_no_date_meet_teacher.text: "...What are you doing here? Heh, teachers get weekends too, you know. Well, want to grab a coffee or something?"

day4_no_date_chat_teacher.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_teacher.text: *The homeroom teacher says it with a straight face, but she's the one who started the conversation. I even caught the slight curve of a smile on her lips.*

day4_no_date_after_encounter.name: Me
day4_no_date_after_encounter.text: *We walked together for a while, chatting about this and that. I never imagined my weekend would turn out like this.*

day4_no_date_reflect.name: Me
day4_no_date_reflect.text: *It started as a day with no plans... but just this one chance encounter made today feel special.*

day4_no_date_sunset.name: Me
day4_no_date_sunset.text: *Before I know it, the sunset is starting to spread. The sky turns orange. It wasn't a bad day after all.*

day4_no_date_evening.name: Me
day4_no_date_evening.text: *On the way home. Thinking back on today, a smile naturally forms on my face. I'm already looking forward to Monday.*
